code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(m):
            if grid[r][c] == 7 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r,c)]
            comp = []
            seen.add((r,c))
            while stack:
                y,x = stack.pop()
                comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx = y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0 <= yy < n and 0 <= xx < m and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            top,bottom,left,right=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
            border={(y,x) for y in range(top,bottom+1) for x in range(left,right+1) if y in (top,bottom) or x in (left,right)}
            if len(comp)==len(border) and set(comp)==border and bottom>top+1 and right>left+1:
                for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=2
    return out
'''
